name: July
objective: Studio bookouts and corporate bulk as new channels; protect monsoon renewals; bring lapsed clients back before the race.
strategy:
Book the Studio + Rain Check.

Commercial job: Studio bookouts and corporate bulk as new channels; protect monsoon renewals; bring lapsed clients back before the race.

Bookout: Kitty Party, But Make It Cardio (“Kitty party, but make it cardio.”). Hosted classes are a top lead source (Kwality 394, Bandra 353, Kenkere 281 leads) but convert only 4.6–6.1%. A paid bookout has a host who brings warm friends and pays for the room.

Corporate: Team Building Without the Trust Falls (“Team building without the trust falls.”). Bulk purchase is an allowed 25% case. Corporate buyers bring 10+ new members per sale and fit the monsoon trough.

Renewal: Rain Check (Literally) (“Monsoon happens. Your late-cancel fee doesn't have to.”). Average late cancels per membership: Bandra 1.18, Kenkere 1.36. Late-cancel fees in the monsoon make members feel they 'wasted' a month and lapse.

Lapsed: Gone With the Wind, Back With the Rain (“Left us in the summer heat? Come back for the monsoon.”). An event with a start date beats a generic reminder. Freezes answer the monsoon objection at no cash cost.
notes: Build: 72 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹8.1L; 79 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹18.5L; 35 winbacks = ₹4.0L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹3.0L. Offers carry ₹11.8L (35% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 51% CRM status, trial→member 26.9%) — not invented lifts.

funnel.dataQuality: lead→trial = CRM 'Trial Completed' status (not attendance-verified); trial→member = trailing measured; see dataGaps
